reason: No auto-charge on the 14-day trial means I'd actually start it, since I can't get burned like last time. But when it ends I'd most likely just stay on the free version or go back to YouTube. Paying monthly for sleep sounds is hard to justify.
objection: YouTube sleep music already plays for free, and the free version here also has a timer and no ads. Would the fade-out timing and the resume-after-waking really be worth 4,900 won a month? Also, I doubt the phone can tell exactly when I fell asleep just by sitting next to the bed.
would_change_my_mind: If on the 14th day my own records showed I fell asleep noticeably faster (around 10 minutes or more) on SLEEP:ON nights, I might pay for the annual plan at 39,000 won.
